title: Elementor Troubleshooting
description: Fix Elementor editor not loading, broken layouts, missing styles, and Theme Builder display issues.

steps.title: Document Editor vs Front-End Symptoms
steps.instructions: Note if the issue is the editor stuck loading, widgets missing, styles not applying on the front end, or Theme Builder templates not showing. Check browser console for JS errors.

steps.title: Regenerate CSS & Clear Elementor Cache
steps.instructions: Go to Elementor → Tools → Regenerate CSS & Data, then Sync Library. Clear Elementor cache and any page-cache plugin after regenerating.

steps.title: Raise PHP Memory and Execution Limits
steps.instructions: Elementor needs adequate memory (256M+ recommended). Increase WP_MEMORY_LIMIT and max_execution_time. Check for 500 errors in the editor iframe network tab.

steps.title: Enable Elementor Safe Mode
steps.instructions: Use Elementor → Tools → Safe Mode to load the editor without the theme and third-party plugins. If Safe Mode works, isolate the conflicting plugin or theme.

steps.title: Disable Problematic Experiments
steps.instructions: Turn off Elementor experiments (Flexbox, DOM optimization, etc.) one at a time under Elementor → Settings → Features. Beta features often break after updates.

steps.title: Audit Theme Builder Display Conditions
steps.instructions: Wrong display conditions cause missing headers/footers or duplicate templates. Review each template's include/exclude rules and priority order.

steps.title: Match Elementor and Pro Versions
steps.instructions: Elementor Free and Pro must be compatible versions. Update both together or roll back both if a recent update caused the break. Check Elementor status page for known issues.

steps.title: Verify Editor and Key Pages
steps.instructions: Edit a test page in Elementor, save, and confirm front-end matches. Test homepage, a landing page, and mobile breakpoints with caching enabled.
